fields.summary: As a clerk I can split a joint title into two individual titles
fields.description: As a clerk I can split a joint title into two individual titles. Two pull requests, an initial implementation and a follow-up fix, both explicitly reference this ticket.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed split agreement, two new titles are issued.
Given only one signature, the split request stays pending.
Given conflicting VINs, the split is rejected.
